comparisons.peer_summary: The company believes workforce diversity enhances performance and commercial success, having previously set five-year aspirational hiring goals expiring in 2025. It remains focused on attracting diverse talent through programs that support inclusive, merit-based promotions in compliance with the law.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS explicitly articulate a strategy for external talent acquisition focused on diversity and commitment to company purpose/culture. BAC reports hiring over 18,000 teammates reflecting diverse backgrounds to respond to client needs, while GS states a focus on attracting diverse exceptional talent to enhance commercial success, noting the expiration of its five-year aspirational hiring goals in 2025. Both disclose an active commitment to diversity in external hiring, whereas MS and JPM disclose similar principles but with different specific metrics or structural descriptions.

sentences.text: The Corporation is focused on building a strong pipeline of talent, which means finding and hiring external candidates who are committed to our purpose and have a passion for serving our clients and communities.

In 2024, the Corporation hired over 18,000 teammates reflecting a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives so that we understand and can respond to the needs of our clients and communities.
We believe that the diversity of our workforce, including diversity of perspectives, enhances our performance-based culture and is critical to our commercial success.
We remain focused on the importance of attracting and retaining diverse exceptional talent.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm focuses on developing a diverse leadership pipeline, supporting vice presidents with coaching and sponsorship, fostering talent at analyst and associate levels, and promoting inclusion through global and regional Inclusion Networks and Interest Forums.
comparisons.comparison: While BAC focuses on the breadth of external hiring volume (18,000 hires) across entry-to-senior levels, GS focuses on the development of the leadership pipeline from within and external attraction of diverse talent. GS details specific programs for vice presidents and analyst/associate levels to foster talent, complementing its external attraction strategy described in D037. This contrasts with BAC's emphasis on the sheer volume and background diversity of new external hires rather than specific internal leadership pipeline mechanics in this specific item.

sentences.text: This spans programs from entry-level hiring through more senior-level recruiting.
We are also focused on developing a high performing, diverse leadership pipeline and career planning for our next generation of leaders.
Many other career development initiatives are aimed at fostering talent at the analyst and associate levels.

comparisons.peer_topic: Career opportunity range and 2024 hiring mix
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm provides career opportunities ranging from internships to executive roles, with approximately 56% of 2024 employment opportunities filled by external candidates and the remainder by existing employees.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM disclose specific metrics or characteristics regarding the mix and scope of their 2024 talent acquisition. BAC highlights hiring over 18,000 individuals with diverse backgrounds across entry-level to senior roles. JPM highlights that approximately 56% of employment opportunities were filled by external candidates, with the remainder by internal employees, covering opportunities from internships to executive careers. Both provide concrete data points on their external hiring activities for the fiscal year.
